channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: ‘Lots of things can still go wrong’ with US-Iran deal to end the war
item.description: Henry Ensher says the US–Iran agreement is not a final settlement but only the start of a process that can go wrong.

item.title: Iran announces funeral, burial dates for late Supreme Leader Khamenei
item.description: Funeral ceremonies will take place in Tehran and Qom before a burial in his home town of Mashhad.

item.title: Five Indian air force staff killed as transport plane crashes in Assam
item.description: Antonov An-32 transport plane crashed near Assam’s Jorhat region, air forces says.

item.title: Israel attacks Lebanon despite being included in potential peace deal
item.description: Israel has continued to attack Lebanon, despite Iran saying it was included in a potential memorandum of understanding.

item.title: Iran war day 106: US and Iran say deal close but Lebanon fighting continues
item.description: US and Iran say a deal to end the war is close, with a final text agreed but key steps still pending.

item.title: Five killed as Israel hits south Lebanon, issues forced displacement orders
item.description: The Israeli military has threatened residents of 24 Lebanese towns and villages to leave their homes immediately.

item.title: Trump seeks ‘off-ramp’ from war in ‘Iran deal’
item.description: As reports emerge of a possible US-Iran agreement, President Donald Trump is looking for an ‘off-ramp’ from Iran war.

item.title: Israel carries out air strikes on Lebanon, state media says, as Iran claims deal with US near
item.description: The strikes come as Iran's foreign minister says a deal to end fighting with the US is close.

item.title: US kills leader of Venezuela's Tren de Aragua gang in airstrike, Trump says
item.description: Niño Guerrero was killed in a "swift and lethal kinetic strike," the US President wrote in a social media post.

item.title: 'I will come home safely': Indian sailor's last words to wife before a US strike killed him
item.description: Patnala Suresh and his wife were looking forward to celebrating their 15th wedding anniversary this month.
